drifting motes of golden pollen hanging in the still forest air around him
thin curls of morning mist threading between the ancient trunks
soft oak-leaves falling slowly past his shoulders on a windless afternoon
a fine drizzle beading silver on his weathered skin and crown
a light dusting of frost rimed along his crown in the cold air
shafts of dust-laden light slanting down through the canopy onto him
floating seed-down drifting on still air at his eye level
warm humid forest-haze softening the trunks behind him
gentle snowfall settling on his shoulders and the boughs above
rising ground-fog pooling around his feet at dusk
a few drifting blossom-petals turning slowly in the air near his face
still clear air thick with hanging luminous spores
a sudden swirl of leaves caught mid-gust around his legs
soft rain-mist hanging in the green light, every surface beaded and gleaming
low evening fog creeping between the roots in long pale fingers
fat slow raindrops falling through a shaft of late light beside him
